original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹就阿卜耶伊市场遭袭事件召见苏丹大使
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹政府表示已召见苏丹驻朱巴大使，就阿卜耶伊争议地区阿米特共同市场遭无人机袭击提出强烈抗议。当地官员将袭击归咎于苏丹武装部队，袭击造成至少73人死亡、19人受伤。阿卜耶伊信息部长称遇难者包括苏丹与南苏丹平民。该地区归属问题自2011年南苏丹独立以来一直悬而未决。

location.raw_text: Amiet Common Market, about 10 km north of Abyei town in Ameth-Aguok County, disputed Abyei region

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹政府召见苏丹驻南苏丹大使，就阿米特市场遭袭提出强烈抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan’s government said it had summoned Sudan’s ambassador to protest a drone attack on Amiet Common Market in the disputed Abyei region

key_facts.fact: 袭击造成至少73人死亡、19人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: that killed at least 73 people and wounded 19

key_facts.fact: 当地官员将袭击归咎于苏丹武装部队
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack, which local officials blamed on the Sudanese Armed Forces

key_facts.fact: 袭击发生于周一上午约11时30分，打击市场中部、南部及北门
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: struck the market at about 11:30 a.m. on Monday, hitting its central and southern sections and the northern gate

key_facts.fact: 阿卜耶伊信息部长称遇难者包括苏丹和南苏丹平民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Abyei Information Minister Yohana Akol Ngor said the victims included Sudanese and South Sudanese civilians

key_facts.fact: 恩戈克丁卡族最高酋长称约12次无人机袭击击中该市场
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bulabek Deng Kuol, paramount chief of the Ngok Dinka community, said about 12 drone strikes had hit the market

uncertainties: 袭击责任方为当地官员的说法，尚未获得独立证实
伤亡数字为初步统计，尚未获独立核实
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
